description.p: Sitak prepares and stacks astrophotography frames using the Siril 1.4.5 processing engine. It accepts session folders and 7z archives, and can export a 32-bit FITS or TIFF master image.
TIFF export supports optional lossless Adobe Deflate compression. Sitak is a command-line application for Linux.
Adds 32-bit TIFF export, including optional Deflate compression.
